liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Eleven** (3 reviews): Reviewer notes this Eleven came only six months after the band first performed it; Reviewer likes the St. Stephen into The Eleven pairing [9][10][14]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Dark Star excellent [6]
- **Alligator** (1 review): Reviewer picks the Alligator, Drums, Caution sequence as the best of all time [7]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best drum solo to date [16]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop on Tracks)** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the jam into Caution and Feedback as a highlight [6]

## The recordings

- **gd68-08-22.sbd.cotsman.14915.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 94 min; rated 4.43/5 by 21 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the stereo MP3 surprisingly good in quality, with very hot playing across eight tracks; The stereo portion of the show has several minor blemishes [1][12]
- **gd1968-08-22.sbd.koucky.gmb.92733.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 82 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is in stereo throughout, with reel-change splices between Dark Star and Cryptical and in The Other One [2]
- **gd1968-08-22.143144.sbd.partial.miller.gastwirt.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 8 songs; 64 min [3]
- **gd68-08-22.sbd.jools.20083.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 30 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer was startled by how good the soundboard sounds; Reviewer describes the sound as crystal clear, though the recording is incomplete [8][16]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Latvala and others had this sequence played loudly at the Jerry memorial, and Gans aired it on his radio show [7]
- Other artists listed for the bill are Kaleidoscope and Albert Collins [3]
- Reviewer claims this sequence was the filler on the remastered Anthem Of The Sun [7]
- Reviewer says the Anthem remaster filler actually comes from 8/23/68, the next day, not this show [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-08-22.sbd.cotsman.14915.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JCotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: A bootleg CD shares this source from Alligator to the end, creating date confusion; That bootleg's four opening tracks (Dark Star, St. Stephen/Eleven, Death Don't, Lovelight) are stereo, differ from this release, and have fade-outs; Reviewer has a stereo 256K MP3 version of this show from GDlive.com [1][11][12][15]
- **gd1968-08-22.sbd.koucky.gmb.92733.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: SBD > Master Reel [2]. Also: This DAT circulated in 1994, with the last tunes from each set missing; The tape placed St. Stephen and Death Don't after the Dark Star medley, before Alligator [2]
- **gd1968-08-22.143144.sbd.partial.miller.gastwirt.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard 2 track master reel> cassette > dat (48k) - provided by Rich Gastwirt [3]
- **gd68-08-22.sbd.jools.20083.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Julian (Jools) Elliott; source: Soundboard [4]
